title: Spanish Court Declines to Fine NordVPN over LaLiga Piracy Blocking Order
summary: A Spanish court has declined to fine NordVPN for non-compliance with LaLiga's piracy blocking order, establishing an important precedent regarding VPN provider liability in copyright enforcement cases.
problem_solved: Clarifies the legal responsibility of VPN providers when ordered to block piracy-related domains.
why_valuable: Sets a precedent protecting VPN services from being held liable for user activities, reinforcing online privacy rights while balancing copyright enforcement.
